---
title: "Index"
---

```{r setup}
library(fhperf)
built <- readRDS("_data/indicators.rds")
cat <- built$catalogue
it <- indicator_table(cat)
ct <- component_table(cat)
it <- it[order(match(it$domain, domain_codes(cat)), it$id), ]
ct <- ct[order(match(ct$domain, domain_codes(cat)), ct$id), ]
built_ids <- c(names(built$indicators), names(built$components))
# A component that is also an indicator (a count) is shown on the indicator's page.
page_of <- function(id) ifelse(id %in% it$id, sprintf("indicators/%s.qmd", id), sprintf("components/%s.qmd", id))
definition_link <- function(id) sprintf('<small><a href="yaml.html#yaml-%s">definition</a></small>', id)
awaiting_note <- function(id) ifelse(is.na(it$since[match(id, it$id)]), "", sprintf("<small>from %s</small>", it$since[match(id, it$id)]))
indicator_link <- function(id) ifelse(id %in% built_ids,
  sprintf("[`%s`](indicators/%s.qmd) %s", id, id, definition_link(id)),
  sprintf("`%s` %s %s", id, definition_link(id), awaiting_note(id)))
component_link <- function(id) ifelse(is.na(id), "", ifelse(id %in% built_ids, sprintf("[`%s`](%s)", id, page_of(id)), sprintf("`%s`", id)))
component_title <- function(id) ifelse(is.na(id), "", vapply(id, function(i) if (is.na(i)) "" else get_component(cat, i)$title, character(1)))
```

Two registers. An **indicator** is a statement about measurements: which
components it divides, how the result is scaled, the period, the direction
of improvement and any target. A **component** is a measurement: a SQL
query returning one row per event, counted or summed by period. Components
are the numerators and denominators, defined once and reused. Every id
links to its charts, and *definition* to its YAML and SQL as written.

Every id is `<domain>_<nnn>`. The domain names the subject matter expert
group that owns the definition, and indicators and components share one
numbering within it. A count indicator is also its own component and keeps
one id; anything with a denominator is three ids.

## Indicators

```{r indicators}
tab <- data.frame(
  Id = indicator_link(it$id),
  Indicator = it$title,
  Domain = it$domain_title,
  Type = it$type,
  Numerator = component_link(it$numerator),
  Denominator = component_link(it$denominator),
  Grain = it$grain,
  Direction = it$improvement_direction,
  Target = ifelse(is.na(it$target), "", mapply(function(v, id) format_value(v, get_indicator(cat, id)), it$target, it$id)),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE)
```

Each indicator's page shows its chart, the latest period, both component
definitions with their SQL, and the data.

## Components

```{r components}
#| results: asis
cat('<table class="table table-sm">\n<thead><tr><th>Id</th><th>Component</th><th>Domain</th><th>Aggregate</th><th>Unit</th><th>Source</th><th>Used by</th></tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ct))) {
  uses <- strsplit(ct$used_by[i], ", ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  uses <- sub("^([a-z]+_[0-9]{3}) \\((.*)\\)$", '<a href="indicators/\\1.html"><code>\\1</code></a> (\\2)', uses)
  cat(sprintf(
    '<tr id="%s"><td>%s %s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td><code>%s</code></td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>\n',
    ct$id[i],
    if (ct$id[i] %in% built_ids) sprintf('<a href="%s"><code>%s</code></a>', sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", page_of(ct$id[i])), ct$id[i]) else sprintf('<code>%s</code> <small>from %s</small>', ct$id[i], ct$since[i]),
    definition_link(ct$id[i]), ct$title[i], ct$domain_title[i], ct$aggregate[i],
    ifelse(is.na(ct$unit[i]), "", ct$unit[i]), ifelse(is.na(ct$source[i]), "", ct$source[i]), ct$dimensions[i], paste(uses, collapse = "<br>")
  ))
}
cat("</tbody>\n</table>\n")
```

## Dimensions

A component may carry dimensions, columns its SQL returns alongside the
events. An indicator can be broken down by any dimension that all of its
components carry, and each indicator's page shows those breakdowns.

```{r dimensions}
dims <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dimension_ids(cat), function(d) data.frame(
  Id = sprintf("`%s`", d), Dimension = cat$dimensions[[d]]$title,
  Labels = if (is.null(cat$dimensions[[d]]$labels)) "codes as returned" else sprintf("`%s`", cat$dimensions[[d]]$labels),
  Components = sum(vapply(component_ids(cat), function(c) d %in% get_component(cat, c)$dimensions, logical(1))),
  Indicators = sum(vapply(indicator_ids(cat), function(i) d %in% indicator_breakdowns(cat, i), logical(1))),
  check.names = FALSE
)))
knitr::kable(dims, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Domains

```{r domains}
dom <- do.call(rbind, lapply(domain_codes(cat), function(code) data.frame(
  Code = sprintf("`%s`", code), Domain = cat$domains[[code]]$title,
  Description = if (is.null(cat$domains[[code]]$description)) "" else cat$domains[[code]]$description,
  Indicators = sum(it$domain == code), Components = sum(ct$domain == code),
  check.names = FALSE
)))
knitr::kable(dom, row.names = FALSE)
```
